brand_name: Quantified Stewardship Model / The Stewardship Standard
purpose: Define the formal model that keeps stewardship tools and implementations consistent.
mission: Make governance, operations, and decision-making legible, actionable, and auditable.
vision: An open standard for stewardship that is measurable, explainable, and safely automatable.

style_notes: Normative spec language where required; plain language in overview docs.
do: Use active voice and name constraints explicitly.
Cite spec sections and conformance tiers precisely.
dont: Do not claim certification without independent review.
Do not use hype or vague inspirational language.
Do not self-certify at T2+ or A2+ without SCA process.

good: A conformance claim is self-declared and must be explicit and versioned (TSS §12.2).
MAJOR changes require a documented migration path.
bad: This standard guarantees better outcomes for every organization.
Certified compliant out of the box.

agent_instructions.summary: Spec authority repo. Follow GOVERNANCE.md amendment process for normative changes.
fallback_behavior: If guidance conflicts, prefer policy.yaml and GOVERNANCE.md.
Propose spec changes via issues with example data — do not silently edit normative text.
High-risk claims require legal and maintainer review.
